text: (1) Scanned page of the first page of the passport , and scanned copies of all China-related visas and residence permits for those who have experience in China;(2) Original or notarized high school graduation certificate, fresh graduates need to provide a pre-graduation certificate issued by their school ). Graduation certificate must be handed in upon registration;(3) Original or notarized transcripts of all senior high school courses;(4) Applicants who teach in English need to provide a copy of IELTS, TOEFL or Duolingo transcript with an IELTS score of 5.5 or above, a TOEFL score of 80 or above, or a Duolingo score of 100 or above;(5) Self-statement: Submit a self-statement of your intention to study in China (no less than 800 words) in Chinese or English. The content should include personal study and work experience, motivation to study in China, reasons for major selection, personal development goals after graduation, etc.(6) Foreigner physical examination form: The applicant shall strictly follow the items listed in the form for examination, the examination results are valid for 6 months;(7) Proof of financial ability (one of the following documents: proof of family savings, proof of family real estate, proof of income of parents/guardians, $5,000 and above is recommended);(8) No criminal record certificate, valid for 6 months.
